title: Multi-drone SLAM
line: Four drones map unknown terrain with LIDAR and correct their drift.
description: Four drones fly over procedural mountain terrain and map it with LIDAR, thousands of rays marched against the heightfield every step. Each drone's odometry drifts; when one comes back within range of mapped track, it detects a loop closure, and a sparse least-squares pose-graph solve corrects every drone's trajectory so the map snaps into alignment.
thumbnailAlt: Point-cloud map of mountain terrain built by four drones, with their LIDAR rays and flight paths, rendered by RunMat
